items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I played with him after they'd get that up, him and Clarence William, you know.

ctx.x: Tulane and Levin. With the two pieces? Sheet music. On Tulane. Oh, Tulane you mean? Yeah, so how long did you help them sell the music? On Tulane Avenue. Let me see. Tulane Avenue.

P-Ron and Williams. Oh, you mean how long did I? Oh, I didn't play with them then. They used to go there, you know. And when we'd go off, well he'd give me a stack of music to sell, you know. He'd go to the streets, folks, and Texas, all them places, and Oklahoma, you know. And he'd give me a bunch like that to sell for, you know. But I wasn't at the place, I just used to go there sometime. I wasn't playing with him then, you know. I played with him after they'd get that up, him and Clarence William, you know.…
